newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Low offer in Sri Lanka diesel tender from Glencore.
newsitem.headline: Low offer in Sri Lanka diesel tender from Glencore.

text.p: The lowest offer in Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp's (CPC) tender to buy diesel and gasoline for May delivery was made by Swiss trader Glencore, a CPC source said on Wednesday.

The 1.0-percent sulphur diesel was offered at 38 cents per barrel above Singapore spot quotes, while the 95-octane leaded gasoline was offered at $1.85 per barrel above Singapore quotes, both on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) Colombo basis.
The combination cargo comprising 230,000 barrels of diesel and 40,000 barrels of gasoline is for May 21-22 delivery.
The tender received seven offers and would be awarded later this evening, the source said.

In its last tender, CPC bought from Glencore 85,000 barrels of diesel and 60,000 barrels of illuminating kerosene at 10 cents per barrel above Singapore spot quotes for May 10-12 delivery, c-and-f Trincomalee.
